about:
O'Neal Manufacturing Services (OMS), headquartered in Vestavia Hills, Alabama, operates as part of O'Neal Industries, a metals manufacturing network active since 1921. The company runs a dedicated structural steel fabrication plant in Fayette, Alabama, equipped with a robotic beam line, plasma and saw cutting, and paint finishing capabilities.

OMS provides integrated metal fabrication services for global OEMs across ten North American facilities. Its capabilities span heavy steel fabrication, precision welding, complex CNC machining, 5-axis laser cutting, and advanced automation, supporting multi-stage processing from initial cutting through tertiary fabrication. The network offers specialized steel sourcing and scalable production for high-volume repetitive parts and heavy-duty welded assemblies.

The company serves industries including power generation, data centers, construction, material handling, transportation, and renewable energy. Its customer base consists of Tier 1 OEMs in heavy equipment and infrastructure markets, with manufacturing locations in Cedar Falls, Iowa; Cincinnati, Ohio; Fayette, Alabama; Greensboro, North Carolina; Houston, Texas; Indianapolis, Indiana; Kingsport, Tennessee; Louisville, Kentucky; Monterrey, Mexico; and Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

OMS differentiates itself through centralized supply chain management, providing a single point of contact for multi-step metal processing across its North American network. The company emphasizes proactive risk management, leveraging a century of manufacturing stability to ensure quality production and on-time delivery, while prioritizing technical repeatability and structural integrity.
